learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic components and operating principles of integrated manufacturing systems.
Evaluates the roles of CAD, CAM, and CAE systems in production processes.
Analyzes flexible manufacturing systems, robotic systems, and automation technologies.
Interprets the integration between production information systems and digital production technologies.
Evaluates modern production systems using Industry 4.0 and smart factory applications.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Integrated Manufacturing Systems and Basic Concepts
Development of Production Systems and Automation Technologies
CNC Machines and Numerical Control Technologies
Automatic Material Handling Systems and AGV Technologies
Flexible Manufacturing Systems (FMS) and Cellular Manufacturing
Production Information Systems, ERP and MES Applications
Industry 4.0, Internet of Things (IoT) and Cyber-Physical Systems
Digital Factories, Digital Twin and Smart Production Technologies
Current Industrial Applications, Case Analyses and Project Presentations
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decision in the academic calendar.
